A factory data reset will NOT restore your device to the OS it shipped with (say you got an iPhone SE running iOS 14 or Google Pixel running Android 10: resetting them will NOT restore them to iOS 9.3 and Android 8.0.0 respectively). Google provides these (and then removes them as newer ones are available) but companies like Samsung and many others do not.
